origin: WP0 register 19 October 2026; exact source text retained. All numeric applicability remains unresolved; no scientific resolution is implied by D1 software scenarios.

assumptions.exact_question: Is a planar ceramic coupon an appropriate first comparison geometry for the intended material-system discovery task?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Use a planar coupon; begin with through-thickness conduction.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Simplifies numerical verification. WP0 thermal spike is synthetic, not an aviation part.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Later compare 2D geometry/edge effects before stress conclusions.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: After D1, reviewer identifies a useful real geometry and duty and records applicability limits.

assumptions.exact_question: Which ceramic pair and processing states give a defensible common property dataset?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Investigate alumina/zirconia first; do not freeze a real pair until compatible data are obtained. WP0 uses anonymous synthetic A/B conductivities.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Existing agreed direction; pairing is NOT established by the synthetic trial.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Pair substitution changes evidence, interfaces and manufacturing feasibility.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Compatible grade-specific property and process evidence with reuse terms identifies the pair and states.

assumptions.exact_question: Can the selected property measurements represent the printed and fired material?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Dense bulk properties are not assumed to be printed-paste or as-manufactured properties.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Porosity, grain size, phase and process history differ. Evidence catalogue must preserve these conditions.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Run alternatives only within supported measured domains; missing mapping stays unresolved.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Specimen-linked printed/fired measurements support the property transfer or define its limits.

assumptions.exact_question: Is isotropic linear thermoelasticity adequate for the selected duty and temperature range?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Use only for bounded elastic thermal-mismatch estimates after reference reproduction.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Existing SfePy thermoelastic example is a candidate, not yet reproduced.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Check load/temperature ranges; creep, damage and phase changes remain excluded.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Reference reproduction and reviewed duty bounds support the selected elastic approximation.

assumptions.exact_question: What stress-free temperature and restraint represent each manufacturing route?
assumptions.provisional_answer: No single universal firing temperature is assigned. Require explicit scenario values and provenance.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Thermal strain depends on history and constraints.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Sweep justified reference-temperature and restraint scenarios; report ranking reversals.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Route-specific evidence identifies stress-free state and restraint, with sensitivity recorded.

assumptions.exact_question: How should constituent properties map across a composition gradient?
assumptions.provisional_answer: No undocumented mixture rule is accepted as measured evidence. Synthetic spatial conductivity is prescribed directly in WP0.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Constituent endpoints alone do not establish effective mixture properties.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Compare supported bounds/laws only after their applicability is documented.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: A documented existing mapping is qualified against compatible intermediate compositions.

assumptions.exact_question: Are perfectly bonded interfaces a reasonable first assumption?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Treat perfect bonding as an explicit idealisation, never as demonstrated interface strength.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Existing continuum interface treatment; no adhesion data established.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Contact resistance/interface compliance scenarios where supported; otherwise mark unassessed.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Interface evidence and reference checks support the idealisation or quantify its limitations.

assumptions.exact_question: Which stress metric is informative for cracking or delamination?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Retain signed tensile/compressive fields and use nonsingular regional measures; no lifetime claim.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Compression can help one failure mode while another worsens.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Region/mesh checks and separate interface assessment.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Reviewer accepts defined signed regional stress measures and their failure interpretation limits.

assumptions.exact_question: Is finite layer/feed resolution an adequate first manufacturing feedback mechanism, or is mixing lag essential?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Evaluate the simplest evidenced mechanism; do not invent a mixing time constant.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Process capabilities require source-specific parameters. WP0 has not implemented manufacturing physics.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Compare intended and achieved fields, then recompute; unresolved process data block physical coupling.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Measured process resolution or transition observations qualify the mechanism and its input range.

assumptions.exact_question: Which drying, debinding, sintering and phase-change mechanisms could reverse the comparison?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Full residual stress remains unresolved; thermal mismatch is only one contribution.
assumptions.evidence_basis: No complete supported process-history chain obtained.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Explicit exclusions per candidate, not a single confidence score.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Process-history evidence and sensitivity establish whether omitted mechanisms can reverse the comparison.

assumptions.exact_question: Are temperature dependence and expansion-reference conventions handled correctly?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Preserve source conventions; secant expansion from 0 C is not silently treated as instantaneous alpha.
assumptions.evidence_basis: NIST alumina source identifies its expansion reference.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Check strain conversion against reference values and vary interpolation.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Source conventions and independently checked strain conversions agree within declared tolerances.

assumptions.exact_question: Are thermal transmission, mass and tensile stress the appropriate three objectives?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Proposed objectives only; each requires physical units and common boundary conditions.
assumptions.evidence_basis: Agreed multiobjective intent; no proxy score replaces missing physics.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Change objective constraints and test whether the design changes coherently.
assumptions.sensitivity_priority: Useful product refinement; required for scientific framing
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Reviewer confirms objectives, units and common duty; changed-brief tests demonstrate coherent response.

assumptions.exact_question: What material variability and uncertainty ranges are justified?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Use source uncertainties where available; clearly distinguish analyst scenarios from statistical distributions.
assumptions.evidence_basis: No universal percentage or invented probability model.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Report sensitivity and ranking reversals, not unsupported confidence intervals.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Source-linked uncertainty or declared scenario ranges justify sensitivity without invented probabilities.

assumptions.exact_question: What should constitute an independent physical validation case?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Analytical checks verify numerical implementation; they do not validate a printed ceramic.
assumptions.evidence_basis: WP0 verifies conduction and replay only.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: Match published measurements with their conditions and uncertainty before claiming physical agreement.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Independent specimen-linked observations with uncertainty support a frozen validation protocol.

assumptions.exact_question: Does the discovered alternative offer meaningful improvement over an expert shortlist?
assumptions.provisional_answer: Defer expert shortlist and expert-time comparison until the full demonstration is available.
assumptions.evidence_basis: User explicitly postpones son's involvement. Use transparent algorithmic baselines meanwhile.
assumptions.sensitivity_consequence: No claim that expert productivity/value has already been established.
assumptions.resolution_criterion: Post-D1 expert comparison against a frozen shortlist and success criteria assesses actual value.
